checks.name: gate
checks.reason: The build instruction ran single suites and fast checks only. The lead runs ./scripts/verify.sh through the gate lock; the registered teeth cases (finding 338, four with the review fix) were run here through the driver's own materialize() and worker(), not through the teeth run. The four VELDO-0296 cases were rerun the same way against the changed module at the build commit and were still red on their rows; they were not repeated for the review fix.

assumptions: read_project is GIVEN the document reader's read function by its caller and does not load it itself. Reason: VELDO-0296's row reader/one-opener (suite 130, outside this ticket's footprint) asserts that control_space_config.py holds no file opener and no document reader. The module keeps that property; every later caller of read_project passes the read function. If the lead prefers the module to load the document reader itself, the 0296 row has to be narrowed first.

Key spellings (worktree_root, branch_pattern, landing_refs, build_output, build_variables, keep, evidence_caches, needs, protect) and refusal codes (space_file_invalid:<key>, space_file_unreadable, raised as ProjectSpaceError) are this ticket's reading of design 6.8, which names the keys in words.

The default branch pattern is agent/{agent}/{ticket}, from the agent branches Veldo creates (refs/heads/agent/<agent>/<name>, engine/scripts/agent_sandbox.py). How a matched name gives a ticket id is the hook's and reconcile's work in later tickets.

The default of needs is nothing declared per station. Measuring after five runs and falling back to the pool default belong to the admission tickets. A pool name under needs is checked against the installation's pools when the installation names any (review finding 1); with space management off it is accepted as written.

A key written with nothing under it gets its default, so a laid file with every key present and commented is accepted. A relative worktree root or protect path is resolved against the repository; keep and evidence cache paths must stay inside their folder.

A malformed value and an unparseable file are refused too; the spec's taxonomy names only the unknown key. Nothing calls read_project yet: the census, init and the ledger are later tickets, so AC2's census clause is shown as no declarations returned for the misspelled file.
docs are not changed: documents for space management are VELDO-0322.
review_fix: Review verdict FIX, one finding, fixed in the commit that carries this manifest (the commit field names the build commit). 1: a pool under needs that the installation does not name is refused as space_file_invalid:needs.<station>.<pool>; the suite fixture installation gained a second pool, engine, in place of the unknown pool desktop.
rollback: Revert the change. Project space files stay in their repositories and are not read.
